parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate a light‑dependent resistor (LDR). You are provided with a series circuit consisting of a power supply, a switch, a 470 Ω resistor and an LDR.

parts.text: (a) Draw a circuit diagram of the circuit that has been set up for you. Choose symbols from the list in Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1 [2]

parts.text: (c) (i) The current I in the circuit is calculated using the equation: I = V XY R , where R = 470 Ω. Use your voltmeter reading in (b)(i) to calculate the current I. I = ...................................................... A [1]

parts.text: (ii) The resistance of the LDR is calculated using the equation: R = V YZ I . Use your voltmeter reading in (b)(ii) to calculate the resistance R of the LDR. R = ..................................................... Ω [1]
